description: The line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens for two different models: "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information." The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," ranges from 0.6 to 1.4 and is marked with major ticks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," ranges from 48 to 58 and is marked with major ticks at intervals of 2. The "MATTER (ours)" model is represented by a red line with circular markers, while the "w/o material information" model is represented by a dark purple line with circular markers. The "MATTER (ours)" line starts at a Macro-F1 Score of approximately 55.5% at 0.6 tokens, decreases to about 54.5% at 0.7 tokens, then rises to a peak of 58% at 1.0 token, and subsequently declines to approximately 51.5% at 1.5 tokens. The "w/o material information" line starts at a Macro-F1 Score of approximately 52.5% at 0.6 tokens, increases to a peak of 54.5% at 0.7 tokens, then remains relatively stable around 53.5% until 1.2 tokens, after which it declines to approximately 52% at 1.4 tokens, and then drops sharply to about 48% at 1.5 tokens.
